title: A bankruptcy court delays Google's $10M purchase of Spirit Airlines' data after former flight attendants objected, seeking assurance their info would be removed (Alexander Gladstone/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Alexander Gladstone / Wall Street Journal: A bankruptcy court delays Google's $10M purchase of Spirit Airlines' data after former flight attendants objected, seeking assurance their info would be removed — The flight attendants want assurance that their confidential information will be removed from the sale of the defunct airline's digital records
